text: A student may not register for a course without having passed all the hard prerequisites specified in the Courses of Study.

name: Liberal Arts HSS Credit Requirement
text: All B.Tech students are required to complete a minimum of 6 credits from the designated Liberal Arts / Humanities and Social Sciences basket.

name: B.Tech CSE Minimum Degree Credits
text: The minimum credit requirement for the award of the B.Tech degree in Computer Science and Engineering is 136-140 credits.
